scripts.dev:emulator: node scripts/free-ports.mjs && npx -y firebase-tools@14 emulators:exec --only firestore,auth "node scripts/seed-emulator.mjs && vite --mode emulator"
scripts.test:rules: node scripts/free-ports.mjs && npx -y firebase-tools@14 emulators:exec --only firestore,auth "vitest run --project rules --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile=reports/raw/rules.json"
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/free-ports.mjs && npx -y firebase-tools@14 emulators:exec --only firestore,auth "vitest run --project integration --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile=reports/raw/integration.json"
scripts.test:backend: node scripts/free-ports.mjs && npx -y firebase-tools@14 emulators:exec --only firestore,auth "vitest run --project rules --project integration --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile=reports/raw/backend.json"
scripts.test:full: npm run reports:clean && npm run coverage:unit && npm run coverage:integration && npm run coverage:component && npm run test:e2e && npm run coverage:check && npm run test:artifact && npm run report
scripts.coverage:integration: node scripts/free-ports.mjs && npx -y firebase-tools@14 emulators:exec --only firestore,auth "vitest run --project rules --project integration --reporter=json --outputFile=reports/raw/backend.json --coverage --coverage.reportsDirectory=reports/raw/coverage/integration"
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage:unit && npm run coverage:integration && npm run coverage:component && node scripts/coverage.mjs
